offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures rigid packaging for consumer goods and food companies. Products include metal food cans, dispensing and specialty closures, and custom plastic containers, made in plants located near customers and sold mainly under long-term contracts.

primary_products.value: metal food cans; metal and plastic closures; dispensing systems (pumps, sprayers, dispensers); custom plastic containers; aerosol and specialty metal containers

customer_segment.value: B2B: Food processors, pet food makers, beverage, health and beauty, household and personal care brands, and consumer product companies

end_markets.value: food and pet food; beverage; health and beauty; household and personal care; pharmaceutical and healthcare

revenue_model.value: product sales: Packaging and closures sold under multi-year supply contracts, with raw material costs largely passed through

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Converts steel, aluminum and plastic resin into cans, closures, dispensers and containers sold to consumer goods and food companies

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Latin America, Asia-Pacific and other regions, with North America the largest

specialization.value: related lines: Metal containers, dispensing and specialty closures, and custom containers, all rigid packaging for consumer goods

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Direct sales to food, beverage and consumer product manufacturers under supply agreements

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Food-contact packaging rules (FDA), environmental and workplace safety regulations for manufacturing
